Skills-lane self-triage (run-to-empty fire; grading my own filing): `finding` → **`pm:queue`**, premise re-verified against today's main before grading: `references/contract-review.md` still carries no re-hang guard (grep empty), and the #11928 通则 row (「被剥不是红灯是放行」) covers only the reverse direction — it tells a reader not to treat absence as a defect, but not the procedure a would-be re-hanger must run. Remaining scope is exactly the card's one line, in `references/contract-review.md`, payment by compression: *before re-hanging a missing gate label, grep the card thread for a standing verdict; PASS comment + label absence + unchanged PR head = CLEARED, not dropped; re-hang only when the head moved after the verdict or no verdict exists.* Fold-candidate with #11994 (same references family, both one-liners).

**ACCEPT (pack)** — PR https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12083, covering #11399 + #11994 + #11220. Draft; governed ⇒ human merge, joins the maintainer's merge list.

Review of record — verified against the fetched branch, not the report: all three rows present at their claimed sites; line counts re-derived locally (contract-review.md 48/48, state-machine.md 43/43, no ceiling touched); the contract-review payment is pure canonical re-wrap (19/19 pre-existing folded blocks byte-identical, sole delta = the new row, and the old one-character orphan line fixed as a side effect); the state-machine payment is two honest compressions with every rule, mechanical step and ⛔ surviving — checked against the diff line by line. The #11220 row correctly lands option 3 only, with the Part-of-can't-close third instance included.

Two dev catches worth crediting on the record: (1) **my dispatch's closing-keyword literal was wrong** (`Closes #A #B #C` binds the keyword to one number and would have closed only the lead card) — the dev used the per-number form and audited the body for stray adjacency; I've sent the same correction to the three sibling pack dispatches. (2) #11399's card body carried a stale ceiling (44 vs the script's 48) and the dev read the gate, not the card. Landing: on merge all three close; `pm:dispatched` off in the same stroke.
